main: "The cisterns below the crypts? Something bronze glitters in the silt, where no light reaches."
"The stair beneath the cisterns is sealed with bronze. Sealed things have keys, or sockets."
"An iron giant tends the old forge. What it guards, it does not spend."
"The foundry masters locked their vault with a hammer-shaped lock. Poetic lot."
"There's an elevator shaft in the northwest of the Undercroft. Runs deeper than any sane rope."
"A dead courtier haunts the fungal warrens. He'll trade a word for a word, if you answer true."
"The Pale Court admits no one without the word. The mushroom ghost knows it."
"Tribute, the pale arch demands. The Countess wears the only tribute that counts."
"Wraiths drink the strength right out of you. The Dawnmother can pour it back — for coin."
"Past the sixth cellar the halls move when you blink. Trust the counted step."
"They say the Everflame still burns, far below. Aldenmoor's wards dim a little each dawn."
"MILWA before you walk the dark levels, friend. Some corridors eat lanternlight whole."
"A drunk swears the drowned kneel to something under the shrine. Drunks see truly, sometimes."
"Chests scream, some of them. When one screams, everything below hears it."
"The Menagerie keeper sewed his pets together. The key you want is inside the biggest one."
"A seraph hangs in chains in the Ember Gaol. Free it, and carry its luck forever."
"In the Null Ward, spells die and light drowns. A lens of void-glass sees what is true."
"Reach the ninth cellar alive and tell the Temple. They keep a lantern for the worthy."
postgame: "The brazier burns brighter than any dawn. They did it. They actually did it."
"Ward-Bearers drink free at the Griffin. House rule, as of forever."
"The wards sing at night now. The deep things have stopped climbing."
"Something older than Vexis stirred when the flame came home. Rumors, surely."
